## If you want only to use take the L, download this mod (https://runeforge.dev/mods/f51b4f11-8b86-4de0-b49e-4fc2644e6b6b)

This mod is an update from the previous mod. 

Changes his emotes ( ctrl + 1 2 3 )
Ctrl +1 = griddy


Ctrl +2 = take the L


Ctrl +3 = torture dance from Jojo or the viego dance from his skin

### Works on all skins
